descZh: 登录时显示详细的状态消息，便于排查启动问题。
descEn: Shows detailed status messages during sign-in for troubleshooting.

zh: 隐藏新版 Outlook 开关
descZh: 隐藏 Outlook 里「试用新版 Outlook」的切换按钮。
descEn: Hides the Try the new Outlook toggle in classic Outlook.

descZh: 滚动条不再自动隐藏，鼠标操作更直观。
descEn: Keeps scrollbars visible instead of hiding them when idle.

descZh: 关闭 MPO，可缓解部分显卡的闪烁与黑屏，但会增加一点功耗。
descEn: Disables MPO, which can fix flicker or black screens on some GPUs at a small power cost.

descZh: 停止自动安装推广应用、建议与 Spotlight 内容。
descEn: Stops automatic installs of promoted apps, suggestions and Spotlight content.

zh: 阻止在线获取设备配套应用
descZh: 插上设备时不再自动从 Windows 更新下载厂商配套应用。
descEn: Prevents Windows Update from fetching vendor companion apps when a device is connected.

descZh: 停止收集与上传用户活动记录。
descEn: Stops collecting and uploading user activity history.

descZh: 更新只从微软服务器下载，不再与其他电脑互相分发。
descEn: Downloads updates only from Microsoft instead of peer-to-peer sharing.

descZh: 关闭定位服务并禁用地图数据自动更新。
descEn: Turns off location services and automatic map data updates.

zh: Brave 浏览器去广告与遥测
descZh: 关闭 Brave 奖励、钱包、VPN、统计上报等策略项。
descEn: Disables Brave Rewards, Wallet, VPN, telemetry and related policy features.

descZh: 关闭 Edge 的购物、推荐、遥测等策略项。
descEn: Disables Edge shopping, recommendations, telemetry and related policies.

descZh: 在资源管理器导航栏中隐藏「主页」与「图库」。
descEn: Hides Home and Gallery from File Explorer navigation.

descZh: 调低 IPv6 前缀优先级，双栈时优先走 IPv4。
descEn: Lowers IPv6 prefix priority so dual-stack connections prefer IPv4.

descZh: 关闭系统托盘的通知中心与日历弹出。
descEn: Disables the notification center and calendar flyout.

descZh: 把硬件时钟当作 UTC（双系统用户常用）。
descEn: Treats the hardware clock as UTC, common on dual-boot systems.

descZh: 停止自动清理与云内容按需下载策略。
descEn: Disables automatic cleanup and cloud content dehydration policies.

zh: 关闭 RDP 未签名文件警告
descZh: 不再提示远程桌面中的未签名文件，安全性会降低。
descEn: Stops warning about unsigned files in Remote Desktop; lowers security.

descZh: 登录界面使用纯色背景，减少 GPU 开销。
descEn: Uses a solid background on the sign-in screen to reduce GPU work.

descZh: 打开设置时直接进入上次的页面。
descEn: Opens Settings directly to the last page instead of Home.

descZh: 现代待机（S0）期间保持网络连接。
descEn: Keeps the network connected during modern standby (S0).

descZh: 拖动窗口到屏幕边缘时自动贴靠。
descEn: Snaps windows when dragged to screen edges.

descZh: 阻止固件通过 Windows Platform Binary Table 在系统中植入程序。
descEn: Blocks firmware from injecting binaries through the Windows Platform Binary Table.
